# Original media fixtures

The build verifies original SHA-256 and byte length before copying these files to OUT_DIR. Prewarm with `python3 tools/test-assets.py apps/video-player/tests/fixtures/artifacts.json`; `TILO_TEST_ASSETS_OFFLINE=1` requires the verified cache. Keep the existing media generation recipes and decoder assertions. Originals and the unchanged AGPL-3.0 license are independently restored in durable maintenance recovery storage.
